verdict.rationale: The pack offers only adjacent guardrails, not documented isolation patterns. IAM controls who can do what on which resource, budgets and alerts track and cap spend, and Infrastructure Manager preview deployments let you see changes before applying them. Nothing in the evidence describes multi-project or organization isolation patterns that keep experiments away from prod. Missing for 10: documented resource hierarchy (organization/folders/projects) isolation patterns, sandbox-project guidance, organization policy guardrails, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
